In ASML EUV Light Sources, high power lasers interact with Sn material to create the Plasma that generates EUV light. - Develop one or more image-based KPIs that summarize the relevant information

- Create accurate captions and transcripts for Library digital media using captioning software tools

- Edit and correct auto-generated captions to meet quality standards for timing, accuracy, speaker identification, and readability

- Edit captions and transcripts for materials with multiple speakers, background noise, or technical vocabulary, applying judgment about clarity and speaker attribution

- Follow established style guides and quality benchmarks for caption formatting

- Submit completed work to the Graduate Captioning Specialist for quality review and incorporate feedback

- Assist with quality review of LLM-generated captions for non-English language media as directed by the Graduate Captioning Specialist

- Flag accuracy concerns and document recurring issues for pilot evaluation

PDF and Document Remediation Focus Area

- Correct and add reading order, semantic tags, heading structure, alt text for images, and document metadata using Adobe Acrobat Pro

- Maintain consistent throughput to meet team production targets

- Maintain confidentiality of student and patron records accessed in the course of processing materials, consistent with FERPA and Library privacy policies

Intelligent machines that can perceive, reason, and safely interact with people and the physical world are rapidly becoming a reality. For example, how can we:

- Build systems that reason under uncertainty and interact safely and naturally with people and other agents?

We also investigate related areas including decision-making under uncertainty, deep learning, reinforcement learning, simulation, and the verification and validation of safety-critical AI systems. Our focus is on fundamental research, and lab members are encouraged to publish their work and open-source their code.
